skills.name: mysql-shared
skills.description: mysql-cli shared rules: config & datasource, global flags, output formats, error recovery, safety model, stable exit codes. Required by mysql-query and mysql-schema; install all three together.

skills.name: mysql-query
skills.description: Run SQL with mysql-cli: SELECT, DML (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), DDL, multi-statement transactions. Read-only by default, JSON output, stable exit codes, tiered write gates.

skills.name: mysql-schema
skills.description: Explore MySQL schema with mysql-cli: tables, databases, sample, read, analyze. Read-only discovery.
